game.name: Moto X3M Category Extensions
game.rules:
Timer Starts on the first input in level 1

Timer Ends on the frame you cross the finish line on the Last Level

IL runs use the In-Game timer

Game audio must be included in your recording.

Farming runs results in a ban, run farmers are not welcome here.

We are allowed to reject any runs that are suspected of farming

Slowruns are banned

As of July 23rd, 2024, All runs (including level runs) must show the ENTIRE run

newsList.title: Sum of best Segments
newsList.body: Sub of Best Segments has been moved to miscellaneous due to the not-so-strict submitting guidelines for that category.

relatedGames.name: Moto X3M
relatedGames.rules:
Please provide video evidence of your run.

Timing starts on your first input and ends when you reach the goal of the final level.

Only select PC as your platform if you are playing on the emulator.

Full game runs must complete all of the levels in order.

Farming runs results in a ban, run farmers are not welcome here, we are allowed to reject any runs that are suspected of farming.

IL runs must have individual videos or screenshots, no bulk videos with more than one level time

Top 3 IL Runs require video of the entire run

Slowruns are banned

categories.name: All Levels Pool Party
categories.rules:
Complete all 22 levels as fast as possible.

You must have a timer on the video

All top 5 runs require milliseconds.

categories.name: All Levels Spookyland
categories.rules:
Complete all 22 levels as fast as possible.

You must have a timer on the video

All top 5 runs require milliseconds.

categories.name: Moto X3M All Levels Flipless
categories.rules:
Complete all 22 levels as fast as possible.

You must have a timer on the video

All top 5 runs require milliseconds.

If you do a flip during a level, you must immediately restart that level.

categories.name: Moto X3M All Levels Deathless
categories.rules:
Complete all 22 levels as fast as possible.

You must have a timer on the video 

All top 5 runs require milliseconds.

If you die during a level, you must immediately restart that level.

categories.name: Blindfolded
categories.rules:
You must show a face cam. 

Complete all levels of the game. 

Timer starts when you start moving in the first level and timer ends when you cross the finish line on last level.

categories.name: 10x Level
categories.rules:
Use of external timer is necessary due to loads being a part of the times. If you do not use another timer, your run will take longer to verify because the mods will need to time it themselves. Timer starts on first input and ends on the end screen of the level for the 10th time.
Complete the level 10 times as fast as possible.

categories.name: All Main Games
categories.rules:
You complete all levels in the 4 main games. The games should be played in this order: Moto X3M, Winter, Pool Party, Spooky Land. 

A timer is required in the video. The timer will start when you begin moving in Level 1 of the Moto X3M and end when you cross the finish line in Level 22 of Spooky Land. 

Top 5 runs require milliseconds

categories.name: All Games
categories.rules:
You complete all levels in the computer game. The games should be played in this order: Moto X3M, Winter, Pool Party, Spooky Land, Moto X3M 2, Moto X3M 3 

A timer is required in the video. The timer will start when you begin moving in Level 1 of the Moto X3M and end when you cross the finish line in Level 22 of Moto X3M 3. 

Top 5 runs require milliseconds

categories.name: Blindfolded
categories.rules: You must show a video of the whole level and have a face cam.

categories.name: Flipless
categories.rules: Video proof of the entire level must be shown, if you do a flip the run is invalid

categories.name: Flipless
categories.rules:
Complete all levels of the chosen game. 

If you do a flip, you have to reset the run. 

You must show video proof and a timer must be shown in the video.

categories.name: Co-op
categories.rules:
Bike audio must be included in your run.

Run must complete all levels in the corresponding game.

Runs must be completed on the correct website.

Levels must be split evenly amongst participating runners.

You do not need to switch off every level. 
You can play all of your levels, then the other person goes, or any combination in between.

Submit in in-game-time and put the real time in the description.
In-game time starts on the frame before the first input (of each level) and ends on the first frame that level end screen appears. Then add all of those times together.

categories.name: Void%
categories.rules:
Timer starts on first input and ends when there is no ground or object beneath the player and all sprites are off screen (besides the bike and background). If you are unsure, make sure the video runs longer than you think so the mods can retime it themselves
In game timer can be used as long as no movement glitches (Such as the timer does not start when a key is pressed) are used

categories.name: One-Handed (MOBILE ONLY)
categories.rules: Must be recorded from another device.  Hands must be shown

categories.name: One-Handed (Mobile Only)
categories.rules:
Another device must record your completion of the run.
Hands must be shown
